triggers.notes: Available from the Lessons catalog as the universal Lesson 0 orientation.
Introduces genealogy, contact, writing systems, standardization, and the family placement of every current Gef learn-from language before language-specific paths diverge.

presentation.scroll_mode: Render all groups as one long-form article lesson in order. The family atlas remains an accessible native-text visualization, never an image-only map.
presentation.pages_mode: Render semantic groups as learner pages with the same source content; do not fork the lesson by tier or language.
presentation.teacher_presentation_mode: Use the same ordered content and family-atlas data with classroom-sized controls; do not fork lesson truth.
presentation.tier_policy: Universal orientation content is eligible for Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3. It teaches no language-specific grammar and therefore does not change any tier's grammar promise.
presentation.variant_policy: Script, region, transliteration, and read-aid variants are representations of a supported language identity and never add extra leaves to the 104-language atlas.
presentation.classification_policy: The atlas is a pedagogical genealogy overview, not a claim that every boundary or subgroup is permanently settled. Contact languages are grouped by formation history instead of being forced into a single-parent tree.
